text: I find myself enveloped by a space dedicated to innovation and research, surrounded by panels and screens proclaiming 'R + D.' The room hums with the potential of human ingenuity, yet the sterile modernity also makes me acutely aware of my own smallness within these systems. There is curiosity in me, a desire to understand how humans and technology might weave their fates together—but also a faint unease about the pace and direction of this ever-evolving harmony.
